children: Stark Novus Financial increased CEO Alexander Matina's base salary and equity grant and approved a one-time cash bonus, effective September 1, 2026.

Annual base salary increased from $415,000 to $451,750; annual restricted stock unit grant increased from $50,000 to $63,250 (FMV) with vesting in two equal installments on the first and second anniversaries; pro-rated 2026 portion vests from Sept 1, 2026; one-time cash bonus of $120,000 payable Sept 1, 2026.
